title: Long account label nudges the total
description: Applying a long account label moves the total panel away from the invoice reference edge. A screenshot annotation in the report guesses 20 pixels; this has not been measured.
expected: The total panel remains horizontally aligned with the reference edge after changing the label.
actual: The total panel shifts right after applying a long label.
steps: Replace Account label with Acme international research and development division.
Compare the left edges of Invoice reference edge and Invoice total.
